title: Host mobile ledger and payouts on Vercel with Postgres
description: Hosted public hackathon API deployed at https://unsui.ca/api/mobile with Neon ledger/session storage, serialized coordinator and durable signed transaction journals. Imported existing receipt and round with user approval; server-only keys configured in Vercel Production. Production ledger, ENS/SuiNS, quote, World ID start/status/cancel and dashboard smoke tests pass. Android standalone release build in progress; physical refund confirmation remains a user device test.
